status: APL-inspired engineered inhibition comparison; not a biological reconstruction

protocol.calibration_boundary: global/local feedback gains selected only from old_train hidden activity to approximate 2% mean active fraction
protocol.evaluation: old training descriptive calibration check, old validation/calibration split, and reused 32-case confirmation set
protocol.local_groups: 32 groups by hidden index modulo 32; arbitrary engineering partition, not anatomical
protocol.global_proxy: relu(hidden - gain*row_mean_hidden); gain frozen from training only; functional global-feedback proxy
protocol.local_proxy: same subtractive rule using arbitrary group means; functional local competition proxy
protocol.native_readout_caveat: all variants reuse the MBON weights/readout trained under native 2% top-k, so readout mismatch can disadvantage alternative hidden mechanisms
protocol.pairing_scope: pattern-separation and discriminability metrics use deterministic next-class pairs only; no nearest-neighbor selection or similar-versus-dissimilar interaction is measured

parameter_scope: same frozen checkpoint weights per seed; only hidden inhibition transform changes

posthoc_matched_readout.status: added after inspecting the frozen-readout mechanism results; exploratory and not preregistered
posthoc_matched_readout.purpose: distinguish hidden representation effects from mismatch to MBON weights trained under native 2% top-k
posthoc_matched_readout.method: same supervised dual-kernel ridge linear head for every hidden variant; per-row hidden L2 normalization; lambda fixed at 0.1 without tuning
posthoc_matched_readout.boundary: supervised probe on the same 32 old training labels; not Novi reward learning, not a production policy, and coefficient scores are not probabilities or confidence
posthoc_matched_readout.capacity_caveat: all probes receive 5177 feature coordinates and 32 labels, but variants retain unequal effective active counts
posthoc_matched_readout.encoder_replicates: PN-to-KC tensors and hidden features are identical across seeds 601/602/603; computed once, not treated as three independent encoder results
